story: Fenwick Island State Park covers 375 acres in Sussex County, Delaware, United States. Established in 1966, it is located on a narrow strip of land between the Atlantic Ocean and Little Assawoman Bay and remains largely undeveloped due to constantly shifting dunes.
matters: The park borders both the Atlantic Ocean and Little Assawoman Bay, offering habitats associated with lakes and wetlands and supporting local wildlife species.
name: Fenwick Island State Park
